overview_description.description: Redis is the world’s fastest data platform. From its open-source origins in 2011 to becoming the 1 cited brand for caching solutions, Redis has helped more than 10,000 customers build, scale, and deploy the apps our world runs on. With cloud and on-prem databases for caching, vector search, and more, Redis helps digital businesses set a new standard for app speed. Redis is internationally recognized as the leader in building fast apps fast.
